## 2026-09-29

### Impact

- **Transact now requires a WebView that supports multiple profiles.** On devices whose system WebView lacks this support, Transact shows a controlled error instead of starting, rather than falling back to the app's shared cookie store. Most devices with an up-to-date Android System WebView are unaffected.
- **Transact's cookies are now isolated from the host app.** Transact and provider login pages use their own persistent browser profile, so they no longer read or write cookies in the app's default WebView store.
- Fixed a bug that could cause password managers to not detect when to auto fill.
- Transact reopens reliably when an app returns to it after the screen that launched it has been closed; previously these later launches could fail to open.
- Integrations that pass a receiver to `Transact.present` now receive the `onCleanup` callback.

### Changes

- Transact and provider WebViews now use a dedicated, persistent cookie profile separate from the host app
- Transact stays connected to its background service after the launching Activity is closed
- `onCleanup` is now delivered to receivers passed to `Transact.present`
- Fixed R8 build failures in minified apps that don't include Uplink
- Provider login pages now use the visible Activity, so password-manager autofill works
- The SDK version is now correct when the SDK is built from source
- Updated internal Muppet and Uplink dependencies (#287, #290)

### Products

- Deposit
- Switch
- Manage

### Requirements

#### Latest

| Name       | Compatible | Build Version |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin     | 2.0+       | 2.1.21        |
| Gradle     | 8.11.1+    | 8.14.2        |
| AGP        | 8.9+       | 8.9.1         |
| Min SDK    | 23         | 23            |
| Target SDK | 35         | 35            |

#### Legacy (`-kotlin1.9`)

| Name       | Compatible | Build Version |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin     | 1.9.x      | 1.9.25        |
| Gradle     | 8.0+       | 8.7           |
| AGP        | 8.1 - 8.5  | 8.1.4         |
| Min SDK    | 23         | 23            |
| Target SDK | 35         | 35            |
